title: Superlogical
summary: A thought-provoking article by Mitchell Hashimoto exploring the concept of 'superlogical' thinking - the ability to operate beyond conventional linear logic when building complex systems and organizations at scale. The piece discusses how exceptional founders and engineers develop intuitive, non-linear decision-making frameworks that allow them to solve problems that appear logically unsolvable.
problem_solved: Explains why conventional logical thinking has limits when scaling complex technical systems and organizations, and how to develop superior decision-making frameworks.
why_valuable: Provides mental models for founders and engineers to transcend linear thinking and tackle seemingly impossible scaling challenges that require intuition, experience, and systems-level understanding.
